narrative:
Material PL1__MB6ADE36 exhibits smooth demand characteristics with Normal distribution (CV=0.141). 
The analysis of 113 historical observations (113 working days) reveals mean daily demand of 13269 units 
with standard deviation of 1877 units. Lead time analysis shows moderate behavior (mean=2.50 days, CV=0.446).

The optimized inventory policy recommends a safety stock of 24,814 units and order quantity of 88,670 units 
(vs. SAP: 0 and 14,098 respectively), achieving a 95% service level. 
The reorder point is set at 57,982 units with a review period of 7 days.

This optimization yields annual cost savings of $10,911.14 (60.3% reduction) compared to the current SAP policy, 
reducing total annual costs from $18,093.04 to $7,181.89. The capacity utilization is 70.1%, 
well within the maximum storage limit of 161,789 units.

The recommended safety lead time is 1.83 days, suggesting to decrease the current SAP value of 3.0 days.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Selected EOQ model for smooth demand pattern with moderate lead times. Normal distribution appropriate for CV=0.141.
